description: Anchor an object in text (Object > Anchored Object > Insert): either a new rectangle, ellipse, polygon, text frame or line created at a text position, or an existing item moved into the text. Set its Anchored Object Options in the same call

at.description: Where in text to anchor: a text frame's story or a story at characterIndex (default: the end), or selection: true for the text cursor

characterIndex.description: Insertion point in the story, counted in characters from the start (default: the end of the story)

frameId.description: Id of a text frame; its story is used

selection.description: Use the text cursor, the end of the selected text, a selected cell, or the end of a selected text frame's story

create.description: Create a new anchored object (instead of itemId); shape is required

height.description: Height in mm (default: the anchored object defaults)

width.description: Width in mm (default: the anchored object defaults)

itemId.description: Anchor this existing item (instead of creating one)

options.description: Anchored Object Options (Object > Anchored Object > Options)

anchorPoint.description: Anchored Object reference point on the object (custom)

horizontalReferencePoint.description: What the object is positioned against horizontally (custom)

spaceAbove.description: Space Before of an above-line object (mm)

verticalReferencePoint.description: What the object is positioned against vertically (custom)

yOffset.description: Y offset (mm); for inline objects, the shift from the baseline

name: insert_anchored_object
title: Insert Anchored Object
